content.text:
name: Build Mobile Apps

# Issue #343: the daily-publish TestFlight and Play legs dispatch this
# workflow in the same minute with different content inputs; the run-name
# embeds those inputs so `gh run list` displayTitle (the ONLY distinguisher
# the list API offers) tells the legs apart — each watcher matches its own
# run instead of latching a sibling's or a stale same-shaped one.
run-name: "build-mobile (${{ inputs.android_content }}/${{ inputs.ios_content }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.1.0) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      android_content:
        description: 'Android: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip Android entirely
          - all              # build + upload + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no upload, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no upload, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + upload only (no metadata, no screenshots)
      # #346: the daily Play leg passes android_track=beta; the input was
      # consumed (PLAY_TRACK below) but never declared, so every dispatch
      # died in seconds with HTTP 422 "Unexpected inputs provided".
      android_track:
        description: 'Android: Play upload track when android_content includes an upload (fastlane supply track)'
        required: false
        default: 'internal'
        type: choice
        options:
          - internal # owner/closed testing — manual dispatch default (issue #289 track policy)
          - beta     # external/open testing — the daily Play leg
          - production
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # build + TestFlight + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no TestFlight, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no TestFlight, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + TestFlight only (no metadata, no screenshots)

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

# Per-dispatch group (#351): the group is scoped by run_id so NO run can
# cancel another. The old ref-scoped group with cancel-in-progress made
# every fresh dispatch — including the daily watcher's wedge self-heal
# RE-DISPATCH (#344) — cancel whatever build-mobile run was in flight on
# main (a manual dispatch, or the sibling daily leg's child in a
# single-leg run): a cross-run cancellation vector. Every dispatch is now
# independent; the #177 supersede-cancellation is intentionally traded
# away. The daily play/testflight legs dispatch this workflow CONCURRENTLY
# by design (#359 — decoupled from each other): their runs tell apart by
# the run-name correlation (#343), not by serialization, and the single
# self-hosted macOS runner serializes the iOS builds physically.
concurrency:
  group: Build Mobile Apps-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351) has
    # a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.1.0"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # The lane wraps `flutter build appbundle --release`; the upload
      # keystore rides the ANDROID_* env vars (issue #289) and is decoded
      # by app/build.gradle.kts into the (gitignored) build dir — no
      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a
      # secret-less release build fail LOUDLY instead of debug-signing.
      - name: Build Android AAB
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_release

      - name: Verify AAB and validate bundle
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AAB_PATH="flutter_app/build/app/outputs/bundle/storeRelease/app-store-release.aab"
          if [ ! -f "$AAB_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::AAB file not found at $AAB_PATH"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "AAB built successfully: $(ls -la $AAB_PATH)"
          # bundletool validate (issue #289 AC3): catches malformed bundles
          # before they ever reach Play's upload pipeline.
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/bundletool.jar \
            https://github.com/google/bundletool/releases/download/1.17.0/bundletool-all-1.17.0.jar
          java -jar /tmp/bundletool.jar validate --bundle "$AAB_PATH"
          echo "✅ bundletool validate green"
          # 16 KB page-size gate (gh-746, review round 1): re-check every
          # native lib in the PACKAGED bundle — a staging-layout change that
          # silently un-wires the gate fails here instead of at Play upload.
          # The gate lives in its own script so aab-gate-selftest.yml runs
          # the SAME logic against fixture bundles on every PR (gh-798 AC3):
          # AAB layout base/lib/<abi>/*.so, owned named verdict — never an
          # inherited exit code (gh-786).
          bash scripts/verify_aab_native_libs.sh "$AAB_PATH"

      - name: Upload AAB Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: android-aab
          path: flutter_app/build/app/outputs/bundle/storeRelease/app-store-release.aab
          retention-days: 14

  submit-android:
    name: Submit Android to Play
    needs: [build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): supply
    # upload historically ~5m.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: needs.build-android.result == 'success'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Download AAB artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: android-aab
          path: flutter_app/aab/

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # Mirrors submit-ios: without the Play service account the upload
      # skips neutrally (the AAB stays on the GitHub release / artifacts).
      # Track policy (issue #289): manual dispatches default to the
      # internal track; the daily Play leg passes beta (external/open
      # testing). PLAY_VALIDATE_ONLY=1 flips the lane into a dry run.
      - name: Upload AAB to Google Play
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the Play upload (the AAB stays on the GitHub release / artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          AAB_PATH="$(find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/flutter_app/aab" -name '*.aab' -type f | head -1)"
          echo "Uploading $AAB_PATH to the Play '$PLAY_TRACK' track..."
          ANDROID_AAB_PATH="$AAB_PATH" bundle exec fastlane android upload_only

      # Issue #947: android_content=all means the LISTING ships too. The
      # listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device type
      # (supply appends, which is how a stale rejected screenshot survived
      # on the live listing) and verifies the committed state via
      # edits.images.list. Runs after the AAB upload so a release train
      # never ships a binary against a stale listing.
      - name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-store-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK")
          echo "store APK size: $SIZE bytes"
          # UT-CI-1: track the store APK size delta against the previous
          # release's app-store-release.apk asset. Threshold policy: FAIL
          # the job when the APK grows more than +10% release-over-release
          # (engine/asset bloat must be a conscious, changelogged
          # decision). The enforcement guard stays commented out until the
          # first flavor release exists to diff against — flip it on then.
          PREV_SIZE=$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=20" \
            --jq '[.[].assets[] | select(.name == "app-store-release.apk")][0].size // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ -n "$PREV_SIZE" ]; then
            DELTA=$(python3 -c "print(f'{($SIZE - $PREV_SIZE) / $PREV_SIZE * 100:.1f}')")
            echo "Previous release store APK: $PREV_SIZE bytes — delta: ${DELTA}%"
            {
              echo '### Store APK size (UT-CI-1)'
              echo "- this release: $SIZE bytes"
              echo "- previous release: $PREV_SIZE bytes"
              echo "- delta: ${DELTA}% (fail threshold: +10%)"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "No previous release store APK found — baseline recorded (this run: $SIZE bytes)."
          fi
          # UT-CI-1 enforcement (enable once a baseline exists):
          # if [ -n "$DELTA" ] && python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if float('$DELTA') > 10.0 else 1)"; then
          #   echo "::error::store APK grew ${DELTA}% vs the previous release (UT-CI-1 threshold +10%)"
          #   exit 1
          # fi

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}
          path: flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-${{ matrix.flavor }}-release.apk
          retention-days: 14

  test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK
        run: adb install -r "flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-$FLAVOR-release.apk"

      - name: Run mobile channel IT suite
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test test/integration/mobile_channel_it.dart --tags integration

  build-ios:
    name: Build iOS IPA
    needs: version
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # Issue #344: a wedged self-hosted worker (lost completion report)
    # otherwise holds the slot AND the in_progress status until the 300m
    # daily-publish watcher times out; a job-level timeout lets GitHub
    # fail the run server-side and unblock the pool + watchers.
    timeout-minutes: 90
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.ios_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Update local git mirror
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$MIRROR")"
          if [ ! -d "$MIRROR" ]; then
            git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR"
          else
            git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin
          fi

      - name: Checkout repository from local mirror
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          cd /tmp
          rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          git clone --reference "$MIRROR" --depth=1 \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          echo "Checked out: $(git -C $GITHUB_WORKSPACE log -1 --oneline)"

      # Persistent pinned SDK (issue #354): subosito/flutter-action with
      # cache: true on this PERSISTENT runner cost 5m39s setup (untar ~1GB
      # archive) + 8m47s POST (re-tar the whole SDK) per job — 14.5 of
      # 19.7 min around a 4-min build (run 34815041052). The composite
      # action keeps the SDK at ~/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk with a
      # .fah-version marker: subsecond reuse when the pin is unchanged,
      # exactly one download per pin bump, no cache POST step at all.
      # Still a pinned 3.47.x install — the runner's hardcoded
      # $HOME/.local/flutter is a stale 3.44.4, below the repo floor
      # >=3.47.0 (daily-publish #260).
      - name: Setup Flutter (self-hosted)
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-flutter-selfhosted
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'

      - name: Setup environment (self-hosted)
        run: |
          echo "/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "/opt/homebrew/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # gh-798 AC1/AC2: fail FAST before any build minute is spent when the
      # version about to be stamped is not above ASC's approved floor
      # (#785's class: altool 90062 at the END of the build). Reads the
      # SAME version source the build lane stamps (BUILD_NAME of the
      # version job); the lane skips named without ASC secrets (the upload
      # leg skips too) and fails closed if ASC is unreachable (E1, one
      # retry). The AC4 marker line lands in the leg log either way.
      - name: Assert TestFlight version floor
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bundle install
          bundle exec fastlane ios assert_version_floor

      # Issue #726 (run 35491603044): pub has no retry for its git-dep
      # mirror clones — one flaky TCP connect to github.com:443 ("Failed
      # to connect ... after 11155 ms") failed the whole leg with no
      # retry. The bounded retry + deterministic-skew fail-fast now lives
      # in the shared composite action every enforce-lockfile pub get in
      # the repo rides (gh-1310; pinned by test/ci_pub_get_retry_guard_
      # test.dart).
      - name: Install Flutter dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # #1331 size diet: js_widget_runtime declares `test/assets/` as a
      # package asset DIRECTORY, so its 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture
      # rides every app bundle. Nothing in the app references it (the #1227
      # mac pass verified by grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib and
      # the bundled JS apps — only the package's own tests load it, and
      # those live in the package repo). Removing the file is safe: the
      # pubspec declares the directory, not individual files.
      - name: Prune never-loaded package test fixture (#1331)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # NOTE: no percent-decoding of the file: URI — pub-cache paths on
          # this runner carry no URI escapes; add unquoting if that changes.
          JS_WR=$(python3 -c '
            import json, pathlib
            cfg = json.loads(pathlib.Path("flutter_app/.dart_tool/package_config.json").read_text())
            p = next((q for q in cfg["packages"] if q["name"] == "js_widget_runtime"), None)
            print(p["rootUri"] if p else "")
          ')
          if [ -z "$JS_WR" ]; then
            echo "::warning::js_widget_runtime not in package_config.json — no fixture to prune, skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          case "$JS_WR" in
            file://*) JS_WR=${JS_WR#file://} ;;
          esac
          case "$JS_WR" in
            /*) ;;
            *) JS_WR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$JS_WR" ;;
          esac
          GLB="$JS_WR/test/assets/coach_anny.glb"
          if [ -f "$GLB" ]; then
            rm -f "$GLB"
            echo "pruned coach_anny.glb (5.6 MB never-loaded test fixture, #1331) from $JS_WR"
          else
            echo "coach_anny.glb already absent — nothing to prune"
          fi

      # The workspace is re-cloned every run, which wipes Pods/ and forces a
      # full pod install. Cache it keyed by the lockfile; $HOME-level caches
      # (pub-cache, CocoaPods download cache, Ruby gems, Flutter SDK) already
      # persist on the self-hosted runner.
      # v2: bust the cache — the Podfile.lock was stale (cupertino_http added
      # in 4bcac41 but the lockfile wasn't regenerated), so cached Pods were
      # missing the plugin's native code entirely. The build step's
      # `flutter build ios` runs `pod install` which regenerates the lockfile
      # with all registered plugins.
      - name: Cache CocoaPods (iOS)
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: flutter_app/ios/Pods
          key: ios-pods-v2-${{ hashFiles('flutter_app/ios/Podfile.lock') }}

      - name: Restore vendored WasmRun iOS framework
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The prebuilt XCFramework is excluded from git. Prefer the local
          # working copy on this self-hosted runner; fall back to the upstream
          # release asset if the local copy is unavailable.
          LOCAL_SRC="/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/flutter_agent/vendor/wasm_run_flutter/ios/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"
          DEST="vendor/wasm_run_flutter/ios/Frameworks"
          rm -rf "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          if [ -d "$LOCAL_SRC" ]; then
            echo "Using local framework: $LOCAL_SRC"
            cp -R "$LOCAL_SRC" "$DEST/"
          else
            echo "Local framework not found, downloading from upstream release..."
            # --retry alone skips transient mid-transfer resets (curl 56) —
            # the run-34709113737 failure: reset 3s into the 92.7 MB asset.
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/WasmRun.xcframework.zip \
              https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run/releases/download/wasm_run-v0.1.0/WasmRun.xcframework.zip
            unzip -q /tmp/WasmRun.xcframework.zip -d "$DEST"
          fi
          ls -la "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"

      - name: Validate iOS secrets
        env:
          IOS_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IOS_P12_BASE64 }}
          IOS_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.IOS_P12_PASSWORD }}
          IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$IOS_P12_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "::error::IOS_P12_BASE64 secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$IOS_P12_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "::error::IOS_P12_PASSWORD secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "::error::IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required iOS secrets are present"

      - name: Import certificates and provisioning profile
        env:
          IOS_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IOS_P12_BASE64 }}
          IOS_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.IOS_P12_PASSWORD }}
          IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
          IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Create a temporary keychain for this run (same pattern as learn.ai).
          security delete-keychain build.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
          security create-keychain -p "" build.keychain
          security default-keychain -s build.keychain
          security unlock-keychain -p "" build.keychain
          security set-keychain-settings -t 3600 -u build.keychain
          security list-keychains -d user -s build.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db

          echo "$IOS_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
          security import certificate.p12 -k build.keychain -P "$IOS_P12_PASSWORD" -T /usr/bin/codesign
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "" build.keychain

          mkdir -p ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles
          echo "$IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/profile.mobileprovision

          # The FaLiveActivity extension signs MANUALLY too (the runner's
          # Xcode has no Apple account, so -allowProvisioningUpdates cannot
          # create profiles). Its App Store profile rides its own secret.
          if [ -n "$IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/liveactivity.mobileprovision
          else
            echo "::error::IOS_LIVE_ACTIVITY_PROFILE_BASE64 secret is not set (App Store profile for dev.fa1.app.FaLiveActivity)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Ensure iOS device SDK is available
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Available iOS SDKs:"
          xcodebuild -showsdks | grep iphoneos || true
          echo "Downloading iOS platform if missing..."
          xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS || true
          # The attached device may run a newer iOS than the installed SDK;
          # try to download the matching version. If this fails, the build
          # will still fail with a clearer message.
          xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS -buildVersion 26.5 || true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # The plist is gitignored, so the fresh CI checkout has none and the
      # native Firebase SDK logs I-COR000012/0008 at startup. Inject it from
      # a secret when available (same dev.fa1.app registration as
      # firebase_options.dart).
      - name: Write GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist
            echo "GoogleService-Info.plist written (bundle: $(plutil -extract BUNDLE_ID raw flutter_app/ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 not set — building without the native Firebase plist"
          fi

        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}

          # 1.0.0 build was approved (error 90186) and rejects new builds
          # whose CFBundleShortVersionString is not higher than the
          # previously approved version (error 90062) — pubspec pins 1.0.0,
          # so the daily train stalled forever. Ship the derived next-tag
          # version (e.g. 0.1.446), which strictly increases.
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
          bundle install

          PROFILE=~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/profile.mobileprovision
          UUID=$(security cms -D -i "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract UUID raw -)
          TEAM_ID=$(security cms -D -i "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract TeamIdentifier.0 raw -)
          BUNDLE_ID=$(security cms -D -i "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract Entitlements.application-identifier raw - | sed "s/^$TEAM_ID.//")
          PROFILE_NAME=$(security cms -D -i "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract Name raw -)
          echo "PROFILE_NAME=$PROFILE_NAME"

          LA_PROFILE=~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/liveactivity.mobileprovision
          LA_PROFILE_NAME=$(security cms -D -i "$LA_PROFILE" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract Name raw -)

          IOS_BUNDLE_ID="$BUNDLE_ID" \

      # debug dSYMs under Symbols/. App Store Connect strips that directory
      # from device delivery anyway (TestFlight reports ~157 MB — the
      # payload WITHOUT Symbols), so it is dead weight in the artifact.
      # Repack without it: Payload/ is untouched (codesign validity lives
      # inside the bundle), zip -y preserves the framework symlinks so the
      # manifest shape is unchanged. Idempotent — a future export that
      # omits Symbols/ skips straight through.
      - name: Strip debug symbols from IPA (#1331)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IPA_PATH=$(find flutter_app/build/ios -name "*.ipa" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$IPA_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::IPA file not found in flutter_app/build/ios"
            exit 1
          fi
          # gh-1403: absolutize BEFORE the rezip — find yields a RELATIVE
          # path, and the `(cd "$STRIP" && …)` subshell resolved
          # "$IPA_PATH.stripped" against the mktemp dir (no flutter_app/
          # ancestor) → "zip error: Could not create output file". The
          # atomic-swap mv below carried the same hazard.
          # (realpath: /usr/bin/realpath, macOS 13+ — the runner is newer.)
          IPA_PATH=$(realpath "$IPA_PATH")

            echo "no Symbols/ in the IPA — nothing to strip"
            exit 0
          fi
          STRIP=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$STRIP"' EXIT
          unzip -q "$IPA_PATH" -d "$STRIP"
          rm -rf "$STRIP/Symbols"
          BEFORE=$(stat -f%z "$IPA_PATH")
          # Atomic swap: the original IPA survives a failed rezip (the
          # un-stripped copy still beats no artifact for debugging).
          (cd "$STRIP" && find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec zip -qyr9 "$IPA_PATH.stripped" {} +)
          mv -f "$IPA_PATH.stripped" "$IPA_PATH"
          AFTER=$(stat -f%z "$IPA_PATH")
          echo "IPA stripped: $BEFORE -> $AFTER bytes ($((BEFORE - AFTER)) saved compressed)"

      - name: Upload IPA Artifact
        # Uploaded before the symbol gate so a failed gate still leaves the
        # IPA available for debugging.
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: ios-ipa
          path: flutter_app/build/ios/ipa/*.ipa
          retention-days: 14

      # #1331 ratchet: per-file uncompressed floor seeded from the last
      # release-shape CI artifact (run 37495702186 fa.ipa) with the diet
      # applied. Growth >5% on any line or TOTAL fails the leg — same gate
      # family as the macOS pass (#1227). Eviction is pinned separately by
      # the --forbid deny-list: the NEW-line guard alone only catches
      # re-adds above 5% of TOTAL (Symbols/ qualifies at 99 MB; the 5.6 MB
      # glb does not — +3.8% TOTAL, sub-share NEW), so a returning evicted
      # artifact fails via --forbid in the same step. Also pins the owner
      # hard constraint: the js-apps WASM runtime and LiteRT LM always ship.
      - name: Size manifest ratchet + wasm keep-set (#1331)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IPA_PATH=$(find flutter_app/build/ios -name "*.ipa" -type f | head -1)
          MANIFEST=$(mktemp)
          trap 'rm -f "$MANIFEST"' EXIT
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check "$IPA_PATH" \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-ios.tsv \
            --forbid '^Symbols/' --forbid 'coach_anny\.glb$' \
            --manifest-out "$MANIFEST"
          for ASSET in \
            flutter_assets/assets/wasm/python.wasm \
            flutter_assets/assets/wasm/qjs.wasm \
            flutter_assets/assets/wasm/coreutils.wasm \
            flutter_assets/assets/wasm/lua.wasm; do
            grep -q "$ASSET" "$MANIFEST" || {
              echo "::error::$ASSET missing from the IPA — the js-apps WASM runtime must always ship (owner directive, #1331)"
              exit 1
            }
          done
          grep -q "LiteRtLm.framework/LiteRtLm" "$MANIFEST" || {
            echo "::error::LiteRtLm.framework missing from the IPA — on-device LLM stack must always ship (owner directive, #1331)"
            exit 1
          }
          echo "✅ wasm runtime + LiteRT keep-set present; iOS size ratchet green"

      - name: Verify IPA and FFI symbols
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          IPA_PATH=$(find flutter_app/build/ios -name "*.ipa" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$IPA_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::IPA file not found in flutter_app/build/ios"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "IPA built successfully: $(ls -la "$IPA_PATH")"

          # The Dart side resolves the wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on the
          # main executable. If the symbols were dead-stripped or not exported
          # the app boots to a white screen on TestFlight — fail here instead.
          CHECK_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
          unzip -q "$IPA_PATH" -d "$CHECK_DIR"
          PLIST=$(echo "$CHECK_DIR"/Payload/*.app/Info.plist)
          EXEC_NAME=$(plutil -extract CFBundleExecutable raw "$PLIST")
          BIN="$(dirname "$PLIST")/$EXEC_NAME"
          # dyld_info reads the exports trie, which survives stripping
          # (nm -gD fails on stripped binaries with "no dynamic symbol table").
          EXPORTS=$(xcrun dyld_info -exports "$BIN" 2>/dev/null || true)
          WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

          # cupertino_http trampolines (_NativeCupertinoHttp_*) live in a
          # static pod framework nothing native references; without the
          # Podfile force_load the Release link drops them and every network
          # call fails at runtime ('No asset with id package:cupertino_http/
          # src/native_cupertino_bindings.dart found'). Gate on it here so a
          # broken IPA never reaches TestFlight again.
          CUPERTINO_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " __NativeCupertinoHttp_" || true)
          echo "cupertino_http _NativeCupertinoHttp_* exports in binary: $CUPERTINO_COUNT"
          if [ "$CUPERTINO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::no _NativeCupertinoHttp_* symbols exported from the app binary — networking via NSURLSession would fail at runtime"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ cupertino_http FFI symbols are exported"
          rm -rf "$CHECK_DIR"

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain build.keychain || true
          rm -f certificate.p12

    name: Submit iOS to TestFlight
    needs: [build-ios]
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]

    # for Apple processing (TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, default 5400s
    # = 90m — a healthy slow ASC processing is NOT a wedge); distribution
    # appearance is verified by the DEFERRED store-appearance-check
    # workflow (gh-1041 — a single non-failing probe runs after the upload,
    # the 900s wait-loop is gone). Job ceiling must exceed the lane worst
    # case:
    #   ~5m setup (mirror clone + artifact + bundle install)
    # + ~10m IPA upload to ASC
    # + 90m wait_processing_timeout_duration
    # + ~1m one-shot appearance probe
    # = 120m. The old 45m killed healthy slow submits mid-wait (the exact
    # failure #351 was filed for); a genuinely wedged job is still bounded
    # server-side at 120m, and the daily testflight watch budget (240m)
    # covers the whole version→build-ios(90)→submit-ios(120) chain.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    if: needs.build-ios.result == 'success'

          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

      - name: Setup environment (self-hosted)
        run: |
          echo "/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "/opt/homebrew/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Download IPA artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ios-ipa
          path: flutter_app/ipa/

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}

# gh-1477: [BUG] build-mobile Derive version: fetch-depth:0 checkout outgrew its own 10-min timeout — daily leg cancelled mid-fetch (time bomb, grows with every tag)

## Description

## Problem

The `Derive version` job in `build-mobile.yml` (`:74`) runs `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` (full history + every tag) under `timeout-minutes: 10`. On 2026-10-10 the fetch outgrew the ceiling: job started 05:29:56.8Z, killed at 05:39:56.7Z (exactly 600s) mid-`git fetch` with `##[error]The operation was canceled.` — the whole TestFlight leg of the daily train collapsed to `cancelled` (run 38027695551, issue #1472).

This is a **time bomb, not a flake**: the repo gains a release tag + commits daily, so the full fetch only gets slower. The job needs the tag list and nothing else.

## Fix (pick, or combine)

1. **Blobless clone** — `fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none` (checkout v7 supports `filter`): full tag/commit metadata, no file blobs. Derive version reads only `git tag` — blobs are waste.
2. **Or skip checkout for the version math** — `git ls-remote --tags origin` / API call, no clone at all (checkout only if later steps in the job need files — they don't today).
3. **Raise the ceiling** as a seatbelt (10 → 20m) regardless of 1/2.

Also audit siblings: any other job doing `fetch-depth: 0` under a tight `timeout-minutes` has the same bomb (grep the workflows).

## Never-again

- Workflow-shape test (the `bench/terminal_bench/test_bench_workflow.py` pattern / existing workflow linters): a job whose steps only need tags must not pair `fetch-depth: 0` without `filter: blob:none` with `timeout-minutes < 20`.
- The daily watcher may treat a leg-run `cancelled` by its own job-timeout as re-dispatchable once (it already re-dispatches wedged runs; a 0ms-jobs cancellation is the same infra class).

## Evidence

- Cancelled run: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38027695551 (job `Derive version` log: start 05:29:56.8Z → `The operation was canceled.` 05:39:56.7Z)
- RCA comment: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1472#issuecomment-6095262371
- Twin Play leg (same sha, same minute) succeeded — the window is marginal, not deterministic.

blocks.text:
name: Build Mobile Apps

# Issue #343: the daily-publish TestFlight and Play legs dispatch this
# workflow in the same minute with different content inputs; the run-name
# embeds those inputs so `gh run list` displayTitle (the ONLY distinguisher
# the list API offers) tells the legs apart — each watcher matches its own
# run instead of latching a sibling's or a stale same-shaped one.
run-name: "build-mobile (${{ inputs.android_content }}/${{ inputs.ios_content }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.1.0) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      android_content:
        description: 'Android: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip Android entirely
          - all              # build + upload + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no upload, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no upload, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + upload only (no metadata, no screenshots)
      # #346: the daily Play leg passes android_track=beta; the input was
      # consumed (PLAY_TRACK below) but never declared, so every dispatch
      # died in seconds with HTTP 422 "Unexpected inputs provided".
      android_track:
        description: 'Android: Play upload track when android_content includes an upload (fastlane supply track)'
        required: false
        default: 'internal'
        type: choice
        options:
          - internal # owner/closed testing — manual dispatch default (issue #289 track policy)
          - beta     # external/open testing — the daily Play leg
          - production
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # build + TestFlight + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no TestFlight, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no TestFlight, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + TestFlight only (no metadata, no screenshots)

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

# Per-dispatch group (#351): the group is scoped by run_id so NO run can
# cancel another. The old ref-scoped group with cancel-in-progress made
# every fresh dispatch — including the daily watcher's wedge self-heal
# RE-DISPATCH (#344) — cancel whatever build-mobile run was in flight on
# main (a manual dispatch, or the sibling daily leg's child in a
# single-leg run): a cross-run cancellation vector. Every dispatch is now
# independent; the #177 supersede-cancellation is intentionally traded
# away. The daily play/testflight legs dispatch this workflow CONCURRENTLY
# by design (#359 — decoupled from each other): their runs tell apart by
# the run-name correlation (#343), not by serialization, and the single
# self-hosted macOS runner serializes the iOS builds physically.
concurrency:
  group: Build Mobile Apps-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351) has
    # a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.1.0"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWOR…

run-name: "build-macos (create_release=${{ inputs.create_release }})"

'input/**/*.png' and 'input/**/*.jpg' — find pre-downloaded images"] A2["If image found locally → analyze it directly, no API call needed"] A3["If attachment NOT in input/ → use dmtools confluence_get_content_attachments "] A1 --> A2 A1 -->|not found| A3 end subgraph DMTOOLS_RULE["When to use dmtools for external data"] D1["ONLY if you need data NOT already in input/"] D2["dmtools jira_get_ticket KEY, dmtools confluence_search QUERY, etc."] D3["See instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md for full reference"] end INPUT_ORDER --> CONFLUENCE_RULE --> ATTACH_RULE --> DMTOOLS_RULE ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Bug ticket ready for fix]) --> READ["⚠️ MANDATORY: Read ALL input files FIRST — see instructions/common/input_context_reading.md"] READ --> RETURNED{Ticket returned to development?} RETURNED -->|Yes| PREV["Review previous PR diff and QA feedback in comments.md"] PREV --> RCA_RET["Write/Update RCA explaining why previous fix failed — see output_rules.md for rca.md format"] RETURNED -->|No| RCA_FRESH["Write fresh RCA from ticket description and linked_tests.md"] RCA_RET --> REPRO RCA_FRESH --> REPRO["Write a unit test that reproduces the bug. Run it — it MUST FAIL"] REPRO --> EXISTS{Test fails?} EXISTS -->|No| ALREADY["Check git history, current code, and linked tests.
⚠️ If linked test exists: verify it passes AND the test was created/updated BEFORE the fix commit — not after.
If bug is genuinely fixed — write outputs/already_fixed.json and stop"] ALREADY --> END_FIXED([End — bug already fixed]) EXISTS -->|Yes| BLOCKED{Fix requires external decision, secrets, or infra changes?} BLOCKED -->|Yes| BLOCK["Write outputs/blocked.json and stop — see output_rules.md"] BLOCK --> END_BLOCKED([End — blocked awaiting human input]) BLOCKED -->|No| FIX["Make minimum targeted fix for the root cause ONLY"] FIX --> VERIFY["Run reproduction test (must PASS) and full test suite (no regressions)"] VERIFY --> PASS{All tests pass?} PASS -->|No| ADJUST["Adjust fix and re-run tests"] ADJUST --> VERIFY PASS -->|Yes| GITSTATUS["Run git status and review every new/modified file"] GITSTATUS --> SECRETS{Sensitive or untracked non-code files present?} SECRETS -->|Yes| IGNORE["Add appropriate patterns to .gitignore"] SECRETS -->|No| SUMMARY["Write concise bug fix summary to outputs/response.md — see output_rules.md"] IGNORE --> SUMMARY SUMMARY --> END([End — post-processing handles git/PR]) ``` ## Returning from test-automation failure When this Bug has been sent back to development because a linked Test Case failed: 1. blocks.text:
# gh-1477: [BUG] build-mobile Derive version: fetch-depth:0 checkout outgrew its own 10-min timeout — daily leg cancelled mid-fetch (time bomb, grows with every tag)

## Description

## Problem

The `Derive version` job in `build-mobile.yml` (`:74`) runs `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` (full history + every tag) under `timeout-minutes: 10`. On 2026-10-10 the fetch outgrew the ceiling: job started 05:29:56.8Z, killed at 05:39:56.7Z (exactly 600s) mid-`git fetch` with `##[error]The operation was canceled.` — the whole TestFlight leg of the daily train collapsed to `cancelled` (run 38027695551, issue #1472).

This is a **time bomb, not a flake**: the repo gains a release tag + commits daily, so the full fetch only gets slower. The job needs the tag list and nothing else.

## Fix (pick, or combine)

1. **Blobless clone** — `fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none` (checkout v7 supports `filter`): full tag/commit metadata, no file blobs. Derive version reads only `git tag` — blobs are waste.
2. **Or skip checkout for the version math** — `git ls-remote --tags origin` / API call, no clone at all (checkout only if later steps in the job need files — they don't today).
3. **Raise the ceiling** as a seatbelt (10 → 20m) regardless of 1/2.

Also audit siblings: any other job doing `fetch-depth: 0` under a tight `timeout-minutes` has the same bomb (grep the workflows).

## Never-again

- Workflow-shape test (the `bench/terminal_bench/test_bench_workflow.py` pattern / existing workflow linters): a job whose steps only need tags must not pair `fetch-depth: 0` without `filter: blob:none` with `timeout-minutes < 20`.
- The daily watcher may treat a leg-run `cancelled` by its own job-timeout as re-dispatchable once (it already re-dispatches wedged runs; a 0ms-jobs cancellation is the same infra class).

## Evidence

- Cancelled run: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38027695551 (job `Derive version` log: start 05:29:56.8Z → `The operation was canceled.` 05:39:56.7Z)
- RCA comment: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1472#issuecomment-6095262371
- Twin Play leg (same sha, same minute) succeeded — the window is marginal, not deterministic.

blocks.text:
name: Build Mobile Apps

# Issue #343: the daily-publish TestFlight and Play legs dispatch this
# workflow in the same minute with different content inputs; the run-name
# embeds those inputs so `gh run list` displayTitle (the ONLY distinguisher
# the list API offers) tells the legs apart — each watcher matches its own
# run instead of latching a sibling's or a stale same-shaped one.
run-name: "build-mobile (${{ inputs.android_content }}/${{ inputs.ios_content }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.1.0) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      android_content:
        description: 'Android: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip Android entirely
          - all              # build + upload + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no upload, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no upload, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + upload only (no metadata, no screenshots)
      # #346: the daily Play leg passes android_track=beta; the input was
      # consumed (PLAY_TRACK below) but never declared, so every dispatch
      # died in seconds with HTTP 422 "Unexpected inputs provided".
      android_track:
        description: 'Android: Play upload track when android_content includes an upload (fastlane supply track)'
        required: false
        default: 'internal'
        type: choice
        options:
          - internal # owner/closed testing — manual dispatch default (issue #289 track policy)
          - beta     # external/open testing — the daily Play leg
          - production
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # build + TestFlight + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no TestFlight, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no TestFlight, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + TestFlight only (no metadata, no screenshots)

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

# Per-dispatch group (#351): the group is scoped by run_id so NO run can
# cancel another. The old ref-scoped group with cancel-in-progress made
# every fresh dispatch — including the daily watcher's wedge self-heal
# RE-DISPATCH (#344) — cancel whatever build-mobile run was in flight on
# main (a manual dispatch, or the sibling daily leg's child in a
# single-leg run): a cross-run cancellation vector. Every dispatch is now
# independent; the #177 supersede-cancellation is intentionally traded
# away. The daily play/testflight legs dispatch this workflow CONCURRENTLY
# by design (#359 — decoupled from each other): their runs tell apart by
# the run-name correlation (#343), not by serialization, and the single
# self-hosted macOS runner serializes the iOS builds physically.
concurrency:
  group: Build Mobile Apps-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351) has
    # a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.1.0"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWOR…

# gh-1477: [BUG] build-mobile Derive version: fetch-depth:0 checkout outgrew its own 10-min timeout — daily leg cancelled mid-fetch (time bomb, grows with every tag)

## Description

## Problem

The `Derive version` job in `build-mobile.yml` (`:74`) runs `actions/checkout` with `fetch-depth: 0` (full history + every tag) under `timeout-minutes: 10`. On 2026-10-10 the fetch outgrew the ceiling: job started 05:29:56.8Z, killed at 05:39:56.7Z (exactly 600s) mid-`git fetch` with `##[error]The operation was canceled.` — the whole TestFlight leg of the daily train collapsed to `cancelled` (run 38027695551, issue #1472).

This is a **time bomb, not a flake**: the repo gains a release tag + commits daily, so the full fetch only gets slower. The job needs the tag list and nothing else.

## Fix (pick, or combine)

1. **Blobless clone** — `fetch-depth: 0` + `filter: blob:none` (checkout v7 supports `filter`): full tag/commit metadata, no file blobs. Derive version reads only `git tag` — blobs are waste.
2. **Or skip checkout for the version math** — `git ls-remote --tags origin` / API call, no clone at all (checkout only if later steps in the job need files — they don't today).
3. **Raise the ceiling** as a seatbelt (10 → 20m) regardless of 1/2.

Also audit siblings: any other job doing `fetch-depth: 0` under a tight `timeout-minutes` has the same bomb (grep the workflows).

## Never-again

- Workflow-shape test (the `bench/terminal_bench/test_bench_workflow.py` pattern / existing workflow linters): a job whose steps only need tags must not pair `fetch-depth: 0` without `filter: blob:none` with `timeout-minutes < 20`.
- The daily watcher may treat a leg-run `cancelled` by its own job-timeout as re-dispatchable once (it already re-dispatches wedged runs; a 0ms-jobs cancellation is the same infra class).

## Evidence

- Cancelled run: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38027695551 (job `Derive version` log: start 05:29:56.8Z → `The operation was canceled.` 05:39:56.7Z)
- RCA comment: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1472#issuecomment-6095262371
- Twin Play leg (same sha, same minute) succeeded — the window is marginal, not deterministic.
